description: This file defines an Angular component named 'MultipleChoice' which renders a customizable multiple-choice dropdown menu. It manages options, current selection, and handles change events to update data within a larger application context.

classes.name: MultipleChoice
classes.description: An Angular component extending DynamicComponent, rendering a labeled select dropdown for multiple choices with change handling.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change events on the select element by updating the bound data accordingly.
